    70:       # line 14), so a non-empty list above already implies both properties. Setting this

    73:       # public survival world to the internet. Fail closed, not open.
    74:       ENABLE_WHITELIST: "true"

    76:       # Makes this role the source of truth for whitelist.json rather than merging into
    77:       # whatever is on disk — so removing a name here actually removes their access.

    83:       # rights away on the host. Deopping someone has to work.

    97: # directory, is in the docker group (so `docker exec ... rcon-cli` works) and
    98: # can write /volume1/storage/backups, which was verified before this was
    99: # written. That keeps a `--tags minecraft` run sudo-free on an appliance with
   100: # no passwordless sudo.

   136:     minute: "{{ minecraft_game_backup_minute }}"
